title: Bandwidth efficient live interaction with virtual 3D demonstrator using semantic communication and GenAI
summary: TCS presents an initial proof of concept for bandwidth-efficient interaction with a virtual demonstrator, aiming to extend remote teaching and training.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Semantic communication and generative AI are used to support a virtual demonstrator. The source describes an initial proof of concept and intended use in remote education and workforce training. It does not report a completed learning, training, or access outcome.
purpose: Deliver interactive remote demonstrations with lower communication requirements.
system: Bandwidth efficient live interaction with virtual 3D demonstrator using semantic communication and GenAI

ratings.reason: The virtual demonstrator has an initial proof of concept, not an evaluated training-service outcome.
No student or trainee learning improvement is reported.
Rural education equity is a proposed downstream benefit.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 19: Bandwidth efficient live interaction with virtual 3D demonstrator using semantic communication and GenAI

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A virtual 3D demonstrator targets remote teaching
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
